sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r5/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 5 and Internal Quality Checks row 5 (instruction_leaks_no_grader_machinery); workbook has no cell comments/threaded comments
evidence: Ran the skill's grep (quality-checks.md s5 / deterministic-checks.md:78) extended with gate|probe|functional|polish|visual|render|constraint over task/instruction.md, all three environment/instructions/*.md, environment/assets/seed_data.json and environment/Dockerfile: zero matches (rc=1). No judge, rubric, criteria ids, dimension names, weights, score.py, playwright, model names, /tests paths or sentinels appear. Uppercase-token scan of all test prompts/test.sh found no probe literal (only harness env names such as REWARDKIT_JUDGE, ZERO_REWARD_JSON), and none of those occur in the brief. 8-gram verbatim overlap between brief+notes and every gate/scored prompt.md is 0; app_context.md overlaps only on the public account table (5 shingles of 'sian@kittle.test Sian Lloyd Associate gwen@kittle.test Gwen Pryce Client'), which is shared public data, not criterion text. Agent Dockerfile copies only instructions/ and assets/ (lines 14-15), so no test files reach the agent. Brief's 'try it in a browser ... only ever use it through the pages' (instruction.md:9) describes the user's usage, not the grader. Counterexample attempts: a brief leaking a probe literal would let a stub hardcode it - none exists; seed message K-10 'Boundary note: rent review date is 5 June.' is used by scored/functional/judge.toml:125 but is ordinary seed data backing a public rule (walls-and-retention.md:23 'a message sent exactly seven days ago on a seven-day matter is already gone'), not grader machinery; at most a mild naming tell, no score impact. Not a portal checker run; this is a manual application of the documented grep/overlap procedure.
